verdict.rationale: TruffleHog lets developers filter findings by verification status, which acts as a confidence signal. Examples include `--only-verified` and `--results=verified,unknown`, and pairing these with `--fail` gates the run so only live or uncertain secrets block it. Detectors can also be narrowed with `--include-detectors`, and verification can be tuned per detector. Missing for 10: no severity levels or numeric confidence scores, gating is documented only in a pre-commit context rather than explicit CI build pipelines, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that this reduces noise.
